title: This Free Tool Makes Your $20 Claude Plan Feel Like $100
description:
The #1 community for building a highly-profitable personal brand with AI and Claude Code.
👉 https://www.skool.com/buildroom/

Summary ⤵️

Most Claude Code users burn through their usage because every new session has to process large amounts of project context.

In this video, I break down Graphify, an open-source tool that creates a knowledge graph of your codebase so your AI workflow can navigate structured project information instead of repeatedly processing the same files.

Here's what you'll learn:

• Why Claude Code can become token-intensive on large projects
• How Graphify builds a knowledge graph of your codebase
• How structured project context can make AI coding workflows more efficient
• Why developers are adding this to their Claude Code stack

If you're building large projects with Claude Code, this is one of the most useful open-source tools I've come across.

Check the pinned comment for the Graphify repo and setup guide.

#ai #claudecode #coding #opensource #github #automation #developers #aitools #productivity #tech

top_comments.author: @mindspan_odyssey
top_comments.text: Yeah I built my own version. Codegraph because I noticed this issue he spoke about and I use it. Added a skill on how to use it, so instead of Claude opening files it just passes the file it's looking for or function and it's whole line is brought up where it's imported used from the root to the smallest file. Initially built it to make debugging faster
